inputs: Script location; optional HEX0 environment value.
outputs: Root cwd; HEX0 default vendor/stage0-posix/bootstrap-seeds/POSIX/AMD64/hex0-seed.
state_owner: build.sh owns cwd and selected tool path.
exact_action: Enable set -euo pipefail; cd to the script directory; use the nonempty HEX0 override or default path.
acceptance_predicate: Setup must succeed; no tool revision or hash is tested here.
profile_assumptions: Default points to a Linux/POSIX AMD64 bootstrap seed; an override may choose another assembler.
teaching_section: Reference: establish the comparison environment
claim_limit: A configured path does not establish that its file is the expected pinned assembler.

semantic_purpose: Stop with a recoverable setup diagnosis when the selected assembler is unavailable.
inputs: Selected HEX0 path.
outputs: If nonexecutable: stderr diagnostic with submodule setup and override suggestions; exit 1. Otherwise continuation.
state_owner: build.sh owns the executable predicate and diagnostic; suggested setup is left to a separate action.
exact_action: Test [ ! -x HEX0 ]; on true print a here-document identifying the path and setup alternatives, then exit 1.
acceptance_predicate: Continuation requires [ -x HEX0 ]; no version, digest or assembly-correctness test occurs.
profile_assumptions: Required filesystem/tool access; executable test is a presence/mode check.
teaching_section: Reference: establish the comparison environment
claim_limit: The printed git commands are guidance text, not commands this script executes. No dependency installation or network operation was performed for this companion.

semantic_purpose: Turn seed text into the executable builder and report its length.
inputs: Selected HEX0 executable; 000-seed.hex0 in root cwd.
outputs: Root seed-forth; executable mode; Built seed-forth message with wc -c size and HEX0 path.
state_owner: External HEX0 owns decoding bytes; build.sh owns destination, chmod and reporting.
exact_action: Invoke HEX0 with 000-seed.hex0 and seed-forth positional paths; chmod +x seed-forth; echo its byte count and assembler path.
acceptance_predicate: Assembler invocation and chmod must succeed under shell options; no required 1772-byte size or seed hash is checked.
profile_assumptions: Execution depends on the selected assembler and host. Stage A invokes this route only when its initial executable-seed test fails.
teaching_section: Reference: establish the comparison environment
claim_limit: A reported size is not a content oracle; an observed run would need its tool identity and resulting artifact evidence. No seed was built here.
